messages.name: Aroha Ngata
messages.message:
Kia ora Aroha,

Thank you for your application for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. While your CV showed strong project experience, particularly with your 'FlatMate' app, we've decided not to progress your application at this time.

Your experience building a React + TypeScript app that was used by students is a real strength. However, for this role, we needed someone with commercial React experience, which wasn't evident in your CV.

To strengthen your applications for similar roles, consider seeking opportunities to gain commercial experience with React. You might also be a great fit for our Junior QA Tester role (j14) or the Software Engineering Intern role (j7) at Harbour AI.

Ngā mihi,
The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Sam Patel
messages.message:
Kia ora Sam,

Thanks for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We've reviewed your CV and wanted to give you some specific feedback.

While your recent Dev Academy project shows good React and Git experience, we're looking for candidates with more demonstrated TypeScript experience and examples of shipped projects. Your CV mentions you're learning TypeScript, which is great, but we need to see it in action.

On the positive side, your experience leading large teams as a Regional Manager is very impressive and shows strong leadership skills.

For your next application, consider adding a link to your project or describing what users can do with it. Also, try building a small project using TypeScript to showcase your skills. 

You might also be a great fit for the Customer Success Lead role at Rimu Retail Tech, given your strong retail background.

The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Mere Thompson
messages.message:
Kia ora Mere,

Thanks for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We appreciate you sharing your CV with us.

While your recent React project is a great strength, we're looking for more demonstrated experience with modern JavaScript or TypeScript for this particular role. Your CV shows good foundational JavaScript, but we couldn't see enough evidence of current practices.

To strengthen your application for similar roles, consider adding a link to a project that clearly demonstrates your skills in modern JavaScript (ES6+) or TypeScript. This would help us see your current coding style.

You might also be interested in the Frontend Developer (returners programme) role at Kōwhai Software, which seems like a great fit for your experience.

The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Daniel Kim
messages.message:
Kia ora Daniel,

Thank you for your application for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. While your CV shows strong backend development experience, particularly with "Java and Spring Boot microservices", we're looking for more direct experience with frontend technologies like React and CSS for this specific role.

We noted your experience with "Git" and that you've "started a React course", which is a great start. To strengthen a future application for a frontend role, we recommend building a small React project to showcase your skills and practicing responsive layouts with CSS.

We do have another open role, Backend Developer (Java) at Kererū Bank, that aligns well with your current experience. You can find more details about this on our jobs board.

The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Priya Sharma
messages.message:
Kia ora Priya,

Thank you for your application for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We've reviewed your CV carefully.

While your skills in React and TypeScript are impressive, particularly your experience building "payments dashboard used by 10,000 merchants", we are looking for candidates who already have existing work rights in New Zealand. Your CV indicates you are "Currently on a student visa", which means we can't progress your application for this specific role at this time.

We were particularly impressed by your "Open-source contributions to a React UI component library".

To strengthen future applications, consider detailing your responsive layout and general CSS skills beyond "Tailwind CSS". Also, clearly state your work visa status and expiry.

We encourage you to look at the 'Frontend Developer (visa sponsorship available)' role at Pōhutukawa Payments, as it aligns well with your skills and visa needs.

messages.name: Liam O'Connor
messages.message:
Kia ora Liam,

Thanks for your application for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We appreciate you taking the time to apply.

While your CV shows excellent customer service skills and experience training new team members, it doesn't demonstrate the technical skills we need for a Junior Frontend Developer, such as experience with React, TypeScript, or Git. These are essential for building our customer-facing web features.

To pursue a career in tech, I recommend focusing on building small web projects with React and learning JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals. Practising Git for version control will also be very helpful.

Based on your strong background, you might be a great fit for the Barista or Café Supervisor roles at Flat White Co. These roles align well with your current experience.

Ngā mihi,
The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Jess Walker
messages.message:
Kia ora Jess,

Thank you for your interest in the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We appreciate you taking the time to apply.

While your CV highlights strong UI/UX design skills, including experience with design systems and user research, it didn't clearly demonstrate the specific frontend development experience we need for this role, particularly with React and TypeScript.

To strengthen a future application for a developer role, we recommend building some projects using React and TypeScript to showcase these skills. Also, consider providing examples of responsive layouts you've built with HTML and CSS.

We noticed your strong design background and think you might be a great fit for the UI/UX Designer role (j10) at Harakeke Studio. You can find more details about this role on our careers page.

Ngā mihi,
The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Tane Wiremu
messages.message:
Kia ora Tane,

Thank you for your application for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We've reviewed your CV and while we appreciate your interest, we won't be progressing your application for this position.

The main reason is that the role requires experience with React, TypeScript, and Git, which weren't clearly demonstrated in your CV. We did note your two years as an "IT support technician" and that you "Built a simple internal FAQ page in HTML", which are great foundations.

To strengthen your application for future frontend roles, we recommend focusing on learning React and TypeScript, and getting comfortable with Git. You might also be a great fit for the IT Support Technician role (j11) at Manaaki Health.

Ngā mihi,
The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Chloe Martin
messages.message:
Kia ora Chloe,

Thanks for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We've reviewed your CV and decided not to progress your application at this time.

The main reason is that this role specifically requires experience with React, and your CV primarily highlights Vue.js. We were looking for someone with direct React experience for this position.

On the positive side, your experience building patient-facing features with Vue 3 and TypeScript is a real strength, and your skills in responsive layouts and Git are excellent.

For your next step, I recommend building a personal project or two using React to showcase your abilities in that framework. You might also be interested in the Frontend Developer (Vue) role at Pūriri Software, as your skills align very well with what they're looking for.

The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Ahmed Hassan
messages.message:
Kia ora Ahmed,

Thanks for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We've reviewed your CV and decided not to progress your application at this time.

Your CV shows excellent practical experience with React and TypeScript, having built sites for multiple clients. We were also impressed by your clear focus on accessibility and WCAG standards.

For this particular role, we were looking for candidates who could demonstrate their work through a portfolio or live project links. This would help us see your coding style and problem-solving in action.

We think your skills might be a great fit for the Accessibility Engineer role at Tōtara Government Digital. It specifically seeks your accessibility expertise. We wish you all the best for your job search.

The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Grace Lee
messages.message:
Kia ora Grace,

Thank you for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We appreciate you sharing your CV with us.

While your self-taught initiative and experience building a React app for your school are impressive, we're looking for candidates with more demonstrated experience in TypeScript for this specific role.

We were particularly impressed by your initiative in building a React app that is used by your school's sports department. This shows great practical application of your skills.

To strengthen your application for similar roles, we recommend focusing on building your TypeScript skills. You might also consider our Software Apprentice role (j17) or the Software Engineering Intern role (j7) at Harbour AI, which could be a great fit for your current experience.

The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Ben Carter
messages.message:
Kia ora Ben,

Thanks for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs. We've reviewed your CV, and while your experience with React and TypeScript is a great start, we won't be progressing your application at this time.

You clearly have a solid foundation in frontend development, with recent experience building features using React and TypeScript, and you're comfortable with Git in a team setting. This is a strong start to your career.

For this role, we were looking for a bit more demonstrated experience with CSS and responsive layouts. To strengthen your applications for similar roles, consider showcasing your CSS skills more explicitly, perhaps through a portfolio or by detailing specific projects where you've tackled responsive design challenges.

We wish you all the best for your job search.

The Kauri Labs team
